decision: The exact official Mono-HDR-3D release explicitly describes a materially relevant real-camera observation with four real scenes, 35 poses per scene and five exposures per pose. It does not explicitly extend the repository Apache-2.0 terms to the external Google Drive dataset, provide a path-size-cryptographic-checksum asset manifest, or expose group identities sufficient to freeze disjoint roles before payload access. The source therefore closes before any dataset file, archive, pose, image or pixel request. This is a source-release gap, not a scientific result, and candidate 3 remains unconsumed.
prescore_correction_note: The initial implementation commit was followed by a failed local lint/test invocation: Ruff identified one unused import and the positive rights fixture exposed an overly strict matcher. PowerShell continued to the narrow initial commit, but no formal network audit, dataset request, pixel read, inference, score or scientific report had run. Commit 1662dee7 removed the unused import and corrected only the prescore rights matcher/test text; the contract, source, gates, roles and claim ceiling were unchanged. All formal reports were then generated from the corrected committed source.
next_ready_leaf: None from this exact release. Reopen only if the official source publishes explicit external-dataset rights, a complete path-size-checksum manifest and group identities sufficient to freeze roles before any payload request.
claim_ceiling: Zero-pixel official-source readiness only. No HDR quality, radiometric truth, model reproduction, package/schema/capability, product, stock or candidate-3 admission.
